"''I'm trying my best here!|The flight controller requests Din Djarin to reduce speed|}} A '''flight control operator''' served in the [[Trask flight control]]. In [[9 ABY]], when the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] arrived on the estuary [[moon]] of [[Trask]], the controller asked him by the radio to reduce the speed of the ''[[Razor Crest]]'' due the port protocol. When he did not reply, the controller continued to ask, but Djarin cut the transmission. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] {{Voice}} *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 2|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 2]] {{Voice}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ტრასკის სადისპეტჩერო მართვის უცნობი ოპერატორი }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
